findings.title: AppAuth RedirectUriReceiverActivity must stay exported for Keycloak PKCE (CWE-926)
findings.remediation: exported=true is required for custom-scheme OAuth redirects from the browser/Custom Tabs. Mitigations: PKCE (code_verifier on-device), intent-filter limited to scheme com.altius.altiusfield + path /oauthredirect, tools:node=replace so the library cannot widen the filter, excludeFromRecents/noHistory, documented in apps/mobile/README.md. Do not set exported=false. HTTPS App Links are a follow-up deploy task; nosemgrep annotation on the activity documents the accepted risk for CI scanners.

findings.title: ATS does not pin SPKI; relies on system CA store (Semgrep ATS-consider-pinning)
findings.remediation: Public-key pinning needs production TLS cert inventory and rotation process. Defer until stage/prod hosts and certs are fixed; Keycloak and API use standard TLS with system trust for now.

findings.title: aggregateDaily drops entries whose day string does not match exactly
findings.remediation: Day is still a bare client-supplied string; deriving it from a timestamp plus the report time zone is not done.

findings.title: Rust mirror accepts negative money, unknown fields and an unconstrained payload
findings.remediation: ExpenseCategory now has all 6 variants, structs use deny_unknown_fields, and record_cost enforces amount_minor 0..=MAX_AMOUNT_MINOR plus a 3-letter currency code at the route handler via CostEntry::validate(). amount_minor is kept as i64 (not made unsigned) for wire compatibility; the type itself does not reject negative values without calling validate() explicitly, so any future caller of Store::record_cost that skips the route handler is still unguarded. DeviceEvent.payload remains an untyped serde_json::Value by design (no Zod counterpart either).

findings.title: Operational PII stored in an unencrypted on-device database
findings.remediation: Needs SQLCipher plus a keystore-held key and a retention window; not a code-only change.

findings.title: validateTask applied only on the editor submit path
findings.remediation: Assignment/arrival/completion paths still bypass it. Now lower risk because API tasks are Zod-validated on load (F-05-03), but the chokepoint fix — validating inside update() — is not done.

findings.title: Tool executors carry no caller identity
findings.remediation: Resume is now bound to the approving subject and gated-only, but Exec is still Fn(Value): a future tool would still run with ambient backend credentials. Threading &Principal through Exec remains open.

findings.title: aggregateDaily summed currency as floats across mixed currencies
findings.remediation: Non-finite/negative/non-safe-integer amounts are now rejected and counted (rejectedCosts). Per-currency separation still not modelled — the function keeps a single scalar total.

findings.title: Tenant/hub/actor carried in request bodies, cross-checked only against each other
findings.remediation: No longer exploitable — the API derives scope from the token and ignores the body — but the contracts still carry the fields and still invite the mistake.

findings.title: Server URL never validated as HTTPS
findings.remediation: parseServerUrl rejects any non-https scheme or empty host.

findings.title: Access and refresh tokens persisted in plaintext SQLite
findings.remediation: Routed through SecureTokenStore (Keychain/Keystore); preferences hold no secrets.

findings.title: Schedule CSV built by raw concatenation with no quoting or formula guard
findings.remediation: Routed through csvCell with CRLF joins.

findings.title: OAuth state generated but never stored or verified
findings.remediation: Stored at startLogin, compared in finishLogin, cleared on every exit.

findings.title: agent::resume trusted client conversation state and executed a client-chosen tool call
findings.remediation: Paused runs are sealed as an HS256 JWT bound to the subject with a TTL and step budget; resume executes the sealed call only, and refuses a non-gated tool.

findings.title: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY returned in 503 bodies via reqwest error Display
findings.remediation: Routed through ApiError::upstream.

findings.title: Tenant fell back to an unverified organization_id token claim
findings.remediation: Fallback removed; no membership row = Forbidden.

findings.title: create_task took tenant from the request body behind a Driver deny-list
findings.remediation: require_staff allow-list; org resolved from membership.

findings.title: sync_events scope check was self-referential
findings.remediation: Closed in the store so every caller inherits it.

findings.title: create_task bound $o but never used it; body hub-id planted tasks in other tenants
findings.remediation: allocation (org,hub) clause added, plus a pre-insert allocation check so an empty match can no longer report success.

findings.title: record_event mutated tasks/stops by raw id with no org constraint
findings.remediation: Every task/stop lookup now joins organization → allocation → located → contains; an out-of-scope stop returns Conflict instead of being ignored.

findings.title: evaluateCorridor returned a clean 'inside' for an empty sample set
findings.remediation: Nothing measurable now returns 'inaccurate', not a pass.

findings.title: Device-declared accuracy silently suppressed every sample
findings.remediation: Skipped samples are counted; an all-skipped batch is 'inaccurate'.

findings.title: compareGpsStreams degraded to insufficient-data under attacker timestamps
findings.remediation: matched === 0 with a non-empty app stream is now 'review'.

findings.title: Membership permissions were client-assertable and unbound from role
findings.remediation: MembershipRequestSchema omits permissions; array capped and deduped.

findings.title: LhsReport let the client assert its own approved status and reviewer identity
findings.remediation: LhsReportRequestSchema omits status, revision and reviews; server-owned.

findings.title: Client-asserted tenant/hub/driver and local-only stage rules
findings.remediation: Neutralised server-side: the API derives org from membership and re-validates transitions (F-01-01, F-02-02).

findings.title: Sync receipts matched to local events by array position
findings.remediation: Matched by event_id; unknown ids ignored; a shortfall is reported as a partial sync instead of success.

findings.title: Any non-'accepted' status became a permanent 'rejected' drop
findings.remediation: Only accepted/rejected are terminal; anything else stays pending and is retried.

findings.title: Route guard trusted a persisted session boolean
findings.remediation: Guard now keys on hasSession() token possession when Keycloak is configured.

findings.title: csvCell formula regex anchored at position 0; a leading space bypassed it
findings.remediation: Leading whitespace and control chars now precede the trigger class.

findings.title: API-sourced tasks bypassed Zod entirely
findings.remediation: Each mapped task is safeParsed; malformed rows are dropped and warned.

findings.title: Live adapter silently discarded every task mutation while reporting success
findings.remediation: save() throws when tasks diverge from the loaded set; the toast now fires only on a real persist.

findings.title: Refresh token for a public client persisted in sessionStorage
findings.remediation: Tokens held in memory only; endSession() added to revoke the Keycloak SSO session.

findings.title: Tool arguments never validated against the declared schema
findings.remediation: validate_args enforces object shape and required keys; parse failures go back to the model instead of becoming {}.

findings.title: Roster routes had no role gate; a token with no known role was a full principal
findings.remediation: require_staff on /users,/hubs,/drivers; empty role set rejected at validate().

findings.title: esc() escaped only backslash and quote; C0 control characters passed through
findings.remediation: newline/CR/tab escaped, remaining C0 dropped.

findings.title: Idempotency check-then-insert race
findings.remediation: request-key @unique violation at commit is now absorbed as the replay it represents, instead of 500-ing the batch.

findings.title: Idempotency keys shared one global namespace across tenants
findings.remediation: Keys namespaced by length-prefixed org+driver; replay path returns the stored event-id, not the client's key.

findings.title: NaN coordinates propagated into comparisons that fail open
findings.remediation: haversineMeters returns Infinity for non-finite input; unmeasurable samples no longer reset the breach streak.

findings.title: dijkstra indexed the graph by untrusted node name, reaching Object.prototype
findings.remediation: Adjacency held in a Map built from Object.entries; non-array values filtered.

findings.title: compareGpsStreams was O(n*m) over two unbounded arrays
findings.remediation: Sort-once two-pointer match, plus a 5000-observation contract cap.

findings.title: z.record escape hatches accepted unbounded keys and values
findings.remediation: Keys constrained to IdSchema minus __proto__/constructor/prototype; values capped; 200-key limit.

findings.title: GPS source self-declared, so one device could forge both corroborating streams
findings.remediation: vehicle_gps now requires a non-null vehicleId. Binding deviceId to a registered telematics unit remains a server-side task.

findings.title: Collection fields had no .max() before reaching storage
findings.remediation: Caps added across location, lhs, routes and identity.

findings.title: Money amounts capped only at MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
findings.remediation: MAX_AMOUNT_MINOR of 10^12 per line item.

findings.title: Logout left the previous driver's email and server URL on the device
findings.remediation: logout() deletes all draft: keys.

findings.title: Adapter write and setError ran inside a setState updater
findings.remediation: Persistence moved to a microtask outside the render phase; adapter memoized.

findings.title: leaf() recursed without a depth bound
findings.remediation: Depth capped at 16.

findings.title: A single malformed localStorage value silently discarded all persisted preferences
findings.remediation: Rejected blob is preserved under a .corrupt key and warned rather than overwritten.

findings.title: Callback ignored the OAuth error param and left code in the URL
findings.remediation: error/error_description surfaced; query stripped on entry.

findings.title: randomString lost ~a third of its entropy and emitted a skewed 36-symbol alphabet
findings.remediation: Deleted; both state and verifier use the 32-byte base64url primitive.

findings.title: PKCE verifier cleared only on the success path
findings.remediation: try/finally clears verifier and state on every path.

findings.title: Concurrent refresh could consume a rotated token twice and wipe live credentials
findings.remediation: Single in-flight promise; a losing racer no longer clears a winner's tokens.

findings.title: Per-step tool fan-out unbounded; resume reset the step budget
findings.remediation: MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_STEP cap and a budget carried inside the seal across resumes.

findings.title: Upstream reqwest error text returned to clients
findings.remediation: ApiError::upstream logs the cause and returns a fixed message.

findings.title: Unknown kid forced an uncached JWKS refetch every request
findings.remediation: 30s cooldown on unknown-kid refetches; TTL refresh unaffected.

findings.title: nbf never validated
findings.remediation: validate_nbf plus required spec claims.

findings.title: waypoint_order returned to clients as indices without range validation
findings.remediation: Verified as a permutation of 0..waypoints.len(); falls back to input order otherwise.

findings.title: Unauthenticated /health disclosed integration posture
findings.remediation: Liveness only; posture moved to a debug log.

findings.title: record_report let the submitter set its own approval status
findings.remediation: status forced to Submitted, revision to 0.

findings.title: NaN edge weights bypassed the negative guard and vanished from the path
findings.remediation: Whole graph validated up front; non-finite weights return null, negative still throws (existing contract).

findings.title: User email and pagination cursor had no length cap
findings.remediation: email capped at 254; memberships capped at 64.

findings.title: mockLocationReported was a nullable self-assertion
findings.remediation: Required non-null for app_gps observations that carry a position.

findings.title: Client-chosen idempotency keys were unscoped, allowing cross-actor squatting
findings.remediation: Server-side dedup is keyed on org+driver+key (F-01-04).
